validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: partial. The start-point field (Ust'-Kamovskoye, Krasnoyarsk Krai) is confirmed real via an independent oilfield database (Neftyaniki.RF, Wayback 2017-06-10 capture; live origin geo-blocked 403). However, no independent source corroborates a PIPELINE running from that field through Lesosibirsk to Achinsk. The only origin for this route is a 2018 Financial Times interactive graphic (ig.ft.com/gazprom-pipeline-power-of-siberia/); retrieved the 2018-04-03 Wayback snapshot and searched its static HTML for 'lesosibirsk|kamovsk|ust-kamov|achinsk|abakan|angarsk' -- zero hits, since the route detail is almost certainly rendered client-side from a JS data feed not captured in the static archive. Could not confirm the route from the graphic itself. Searched WebSearch (RU + EN) and GEM's own wiki citation list (leads only, per standing rule) -- no independent corroboration of this specific route anywhere. CLASSIFICATION: presumed transmission gas trunk if real, consistent with the family's other rows, but unconfirmed. Recommend a researcher either access the live/rendered FT graphic directly (if geographically accessible) or locate the underlying Gazprom project document the FT graphic was built from.
